summary:
ASTROBASE: Junior Mission Trainer is an educational space simulation video game designed to teach players about the challenges of human exploration and survival on other planets.

The game allows players to control an astronaut in a third-person environment, explore a space base, and complete missions related to survival in extraterrestrial environments.

Players must manage essential resources such as oxygen, water, energy, and food, protect themselves from radiation, and solve emergencies that could put the mission at risk.

The main goal is to bring science and space exploration closer to young people through an interactive, entertaining, and educational experience inspired by real NASA exploration challenges.
details:
ASTROBASE: Junior Mission Trainer is a space simulation video game in which players take on the role of an astronaut responsible for maintaining a space colony and ensuring the survival of its crew.

The game features a 3D environment with a cartoon-style aesthetic, a third-person camera, and a visible astronaut character who can freely move around the surroundings.

The experience is organized around different missions and activities:

  • Space Exploration: Explore the facilities and discover different areas of the base.
  • Oxygen Management: Monitor oxygen supplies to ensure astronauts can breathe safely.
  • Water Management: Maintain sufficient water reserves for survival.
  • Energy Control: Manage the colony's electrical systems.
  • Food Production: Maintain the food supplies required by the crew.
  • Radiation Protection: Identify environmental hazards and use protective systems.
  • System Repairs: Fix technical failures and damaged equipment.
  • Emergency Response: React to solar storms, electrical failures, water shortages, and agricultural problems.

The first stage takes place in a lunar environment, with the possibility of expanding the experience to future missions on Mars.

The video game was developed using Rosebud AI, an AI-assisted game creation platform. The team designed the gameplay mechanics, environment, controls, and activities to create an interactive learning experience.
